copy.tagline: 在创建时自动建立索引
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在数据创建时自动生成索引
copy.tagline_en: Automatically index data at creation time
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automatic indexing when data is created

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在创建工件（artifact）的瞬间立即为其建立索引，而不是等到会话结束才批量处理。这样下游系统可以马上查询到新创建的工件。
howto.when: 当 Claude 通过 PostToolUse Write 钩子创建工件时触发，即在工件写入后立即执行索引。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新文档并立即索引它。
say.note: Claude 会在创建文档后立刻为其建立索引。

say.text: 写一个代码文件，并确保它立即可被搜索到。
say.note: Claude 会在写入文件后立即索引，使其可查询。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude indexes artifacts immediately at the moment they are created, rather than waiting for session end. This makes new artifacts queryable by downstream systems right away.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude creates an artifact via the PostToolUse Write hook, indexing right after the artifact is written.

say_en.text: Create a new document and index it immediately.
say_en.note: Claude will index the document right after creation.

say_en.text: Write a code file and make it searchable instantly.
say_en.note: Claude will index the file immediately after writing.
